verdict.rationale: The evidence glancingly suggests both port types. A community report mentions ordering a 'Nitrokey 3C NFC' (USB-C), and the vendor shop listing is for the 'Nitrokey 3A NFC' (USB-A), with a community note that Nitrokey ships a complete, standard USB plug. No first-party spec page details the connectors, and nothing addresses keychain or low-profile nano form factors. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of USB-C and USB-A models, evidence of a nano or low-profile form factor, evidence of keychain carry design, independent corroboration of the lineup's breadth.

support.subject: As a power user, the lineup covers my ports and carry style — USB-C and USB-A models, keychain and low-profile nano form factors

citations.quote: I ordered a Nitrokey 3C NFC 2 years ago
Nitrokey contains a complete and standard compliant USB plug
